paragraphs: Arlo Technologies, Inc. ("we" or "Arlo") is transforming the ways in which people can protect everything that matters to them with advanced home, business, and personal security services that combine a globally scaled cloud platform, advanced monitoring and analytics capabilities, and award-winning app-controlled devices to create a personalized security ecosystem. Arlo's deep expertise in cloud services, cutting-edge artificial intelligence ("AI") and computer vision analytics, wireless connectivity and intuitive user experience design delivers seamless, smart home security for Arlo users that is easy to setup and engage with every day. Our highly secure, cloud-based platform provides users with visibility, insight and a powerful means to help protect and connect in real-time with the people and things that matter most, from any location with a Wi-Fi or a cellular connection – all rooted in a commitment to safeguard privacy for our users and their personal data.

To date, we have launched subscription services such as Arlo Secure, Arlo Total Security, and Arlo Safe, and several categories of award-winning smart security devices, including smart Wi-Fi and LTE-enabled cameras, video doorbells, floodlight cameras and home security systems. In addition, Arlo's broad compatibility allows the platform to seamlessly integrate with third-party internet-of-things ("IoT") products and protocols, such as Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit, Apple TV, Google Assistant, and Samsung SmartThings. We plan to continue to introduce new smart security devices to the Arlo platform both in cameras and other categories, increase the number of registered accounts on our platform, keep them highly engaged through our mobile app and generate incremental recurring revenue by offering them paid subscription services.

Our total addressable market consists of individuals and business owners who use smart security devices to protect their loved ones and property. Outside of the home, we have seen adoption of our cellular-enabled products in a variety of use cases, such as neighborhood watch, construction site monitoring, wildlife and outdoor trail surveillance and event monitoring. We believe the small business, government and direct home monitoring channels provide growth areas for us in addition to our retail and e-commerce presence. Our Software as a Service ("SaaS") solution includes Arlo Secure, a subscription service with coverage for unlimited cameras and an enhanced Emergency Response solution, Arlo Total Security, a comprehensive subscription service with professional monitoring and security hardware, Arlo Safe, a personal safety service with panic button accessory, as well as Arlo SmartCloud, a solution that delivers highly efficient and secure cloud services at scale. We believe we are well-positioned to extend our current reach to the broader IoT market both within and beyond the home as we continue to launch new products and services within our smart security platform.

Arlo Secure is our subscription service that provides advanced AI-based detection, DIY home security as well as professional monitoring, and an enhanced Emergency Response capability. These premium services boast support for unlimited household security devices, along with advanced AI object detection, and smarter, more interactive notifications. Additionally, the 24/7, one-touch Emergency Response is available with the Secure Premium plan, enabling Arlo users to directly dispatch first responders during an emergency for quicker action. Subscriptions of Arlo Secure are available with various Arlo cameras, home security, and doorbell products. The features of Arlo Secure subscriptions include:

•AI-powered Recognition and Detection – Leveraging advanced computer vision AI and recognition engines, Arlo Secure 6 provides event captions, video search, advanced video and audio detection capabilities so users can make informed decisions about their security and safety. Users can train Arlo AI to create personalized, custom detections to protect what matters most and can teach Arlo camera to recognize certain objects or changes in view to trigger custom notifications.

•Emergency Response – With one touch in the Arlo Secure App, users can directly dispatch fire, police, or medical responders to the camera's location. If directed by the user, Arlo's Emergency Response team can also provide critical location information to responders en route to better prepare them, such as gate codes, medical conditions of family members, and pet details.

•2K and 4K Cloud-based Video Recording – View 60 days of recordings securely stored on Arlo's SmartCloud platform, for ultimate peace of mind and protection even if the device is damaged or stolen in a break-in, storm or other physical incident.
•Unlimited Cameras – Users can enjoy Arlo Secure service for all cameras in their home with one all-encompassing plan and can add newly purchased Arlo cameras for no additional service charge.

•Advanced Object Detection – Arlo processes and filters approximately 300 million events each day through advanced object detection backed by visual AI, allowing for better recognition of people, packages, vehicles, and animals to add key context to notifications and reduce unwanted alerts.

•Smart Interactive Notifications – Users can take quicker action by responding to rich notifications or viewing an animated preview of a notification video through the lock screen on their smartphone.
•Smoke and CO Alarm Detection – Users can get notified when the camera hears a smoke or CO alarm triggered.
•Cloud-based Activity Zones – Users can reduce unwanted notifications by highlighting specific areas on their property where they want motion to be detected.
•Call a Friend – Users can instantly call a friend through the Arlo App from their notification screen with one tap.
•24/7 Priority Support – Users get priority technical support through the in-app Help Center with omnichannel access to phone, chat, Community or self-help articles.

paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves substantial risk. You should consider carefully the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our financial statements and the related notes and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," when evaluating our business and before deciding whether to invest in shares of our common stock. We describe below what we believe are currently the material risks and uncertainties we face, but they are not the only risks and uncertainties we face. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that adversely affect our business. If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our common stock could decline and you could lose part or all of your investment.

We obtain several key components from limited or sole source suppliers, and if these suppliers fail to satisfy our supply requirements or we are unable to properly manage our supply requirements with our third-party manufacturers, we may lose sales and experience increased component costs.

Any shortage or delay in the supply of key product components would harm our ability to meet scheduled product deliveries. Many of the components used in our products are specifically designed for use in our products, some of which are obtained from sole source suppliers. These components include lens, lens-sensors, and passive infrared sensors that have been customized for the Arlo application, as well as custom-made batteries that provide power conservation and safety features. In addition, the components used in our end products have been optimized to extend battery life. Our third-party manufacturers generally purchase these components on our behalf, and we do not have any contractual commitments or guaranteed supply arrangements with our suppliers. If demand for a specific component increases, we may not be able to obtain an adequate number of that component in a timely manner or at all. In addition, if worldwide demand for the components increases significantly, the availability of these components could be limited. Further, our suppliers may experience financial or other difficulties as a result of uncertain and weak worldwide economic conditions. Other factors that may affect our suppliers' ability or willingness to supply components to us include internal management or reorganizational issues, such as roll-out of new equipment which may delay or disrupt supply of previously forecasted components, or industry consolidation and divestitures, which may result in changed business and product priorities among certain suppliers. It could be difficult, costly, and time consuming to obtain alternative sources for these components, or to change product designs to make use of alternative components. In addition, difficulties in transitioning from an existing supplier to a new supplier could create delays in component availability that would have a significant impact on our ability to fulfill orders for our products.

We generally provide our third-party manufacturers with a rolling forecast of demand, which they use to determine our material and component requirements. Lead times for ordering materials and components vary significantly and depend on various factors, such as the specific supplier, contract terms, and demand and supply for a component at a given time. Some of our components have long lead times, such as wireless local area network chipsets, physical layer transceivers, connector jacks, and metal and plastic enclosures. If our forecasts are not timely provided or are lower than our actual requirements, our third-party manufacturers may be unable to manufacture products in a timely manner or at all. If our forecasts are too high, our third-party manufacturers will be unable to use the components they have purchased on our behalf. The cost of the components used in our products tends to drop rapidly as volumes increase and the technologies mature. Therefore, if our third-party manufacturers are unable to promptly use components purchased on our behalf, our cost of producing products may be higher than our competitors due to an oversupply of higher-priced components. Moreover, if they are unable to use components ordered at our direction, we will need to reimburse them for any losses they incur.

If we are unable to obtain a sufficient supply of components, or if we experience any interruption in the supply of components, our product shipments could be reduced or delayed or our cost of obtaining these components may increase. In addition, sole suppliers of highly specialized components may provide, or have provided components that were either

defective or did not meet the criteria required by us or our manufacturers, retailers, distributors, or other channel partners, resulting in delays, lost revenue opportunities, and potentially substantial write-offs.

paragraphs: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with "Note about Forward-Looking Statements", Part I, Item 1A "Risk Factors," and our audited consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes to the financial statements included under Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

This discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. The forward-looking statements are not historical facts, but rather are based on current expectations, estimates, assumptions and projections about our industry, business and future financial results. Our actual results could differ materially from the results contemplated by these forward-looking statements due to a number of factors, including those discussed under "Risk Factors" in Part I, Item 1A above.

Arlo is transforming the ways in which people can protect everything that matters to them with advanced home, business, and personal security services that combine a globally scaled cloud platform, advanced monitoring and analytics capabilities, and award-winning app-controlled devices to create a personalized security ecosystem. Arlo's deep expertise in cloud services, cutting-edge AI and computer vision analytics, wireless connectivity and intuitive user experience design delivers seamless, smart home security for Arlo users that is easy to setup and engage with every day. Our highly secure, cloud-based platform provides users with visibility, insight and a powerful means to help protect and connect in real-time with the people and things that matter most, from any location with a Wi-Fi or a cellular connection – all rooted in a commitment to safeguard privacy for our users and their personal data.

Since the launch of our first product in December 2014, we have shipped over 42.7 million smart security devices. As of December 31, 2025, the Arlo platform had approximately 12.1 million cumulative registered accounts across more than 100 countries around the world coupled with approximately 5.7 million cumulative paid accounts and annual recurring revenue of $330.5 million.

We conduct business across three geographic regions—(i) the Americas; (ii) Europe, Middle-East and Africa ("EMEA"); and (iii) Asia Pacific ("APAC")—and we primarily generate revenue by selling paid subscription services, as well as devices through retail, wholesale distribution, wireless carrier channels, security solution providers, and Arlo's direct to consumer store. For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we generated total revenue of $529.3 million and $510.9 million, respectively. Income from operations was $6.1 million and our loss from operations was $34.9 million for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

Our goal is to continue to develop innovative, world-class smart security solutions to expand and further monetize our current and future user and paid account bases. We believe that the growth of our business is dependent on many factors, including our ability to innovate and launch successful new products on a timely basis and grow our installed base, to increase subscription-based recurring revenue, to invest in channel and other strategic partnerships and to continue our global expansion. We expect to increase our investment in research and development going forward as we continue to introduce new and innovative products and services to enhance the Arlo platform and compete for engineering talent. We also expect our sales and marketing expenses to increase in the future as we invest in marketing to drive demand for our products and services.

In addition to the measures presented in our consolidated financial statements, we use the following key metrics to evaluate our business, measure our performance, develop financial forecasts and make strategic decisions. We believe these key business metrics provide useful information by offering the ability to make more meaningful period-to-period comparisons of our on-going operating results and a better understanding of how management plans and measures our underlying business. Our key business metrics may be calculated in a manner different from the same key business metrics used by other companies. We regularly review our processes for calculating these metrics, and from time to time we may discover a need to make adjustments to better reflect our business. We believe that any such adjustments are immaterial unless otherwise stated.

Cumulative Registered Accounts. Registered accounts at the end of a particular period are defined as the number of unique registered accounts on the Arlo platform. The number of registered accounts on the Arlo platform does not directly correspond to the number of users. A single account may be shared by multiple users (which we consider as one account) and a single user may have multiple accounts (which we consider as multiple accounts).

Cumulative Paid Accounts. Paid accounts at the end of a particular period are defined as any account worldwide where a subscription-based or otherwise recurring service fee was collected by Arlo (either directly from a user or from a partner).

Annual Recurring Revenue. We believe ARR enables measurement of our business initiatives and serves as an indicator of our future growth. ARR represents and is defined as the annualized paid subscriptions and services revenue we expect to recognize from subscription contracts, as calculated by taking the average paid subscriptions and services revenue per paid account of the reporting period multiplied by the number of paid accounts at the end of the reporting period. ARR is a performance metric and should be viewed independently of revenue and deferred revenue, and is not intended to be a substitute for, or combined with, any of these items.

The U.S. government implemented new tariff measures affecting a broad range of imported materials. Certain countries have responded to the U.S. tariffs by imposing or threatening retaliatory tariffs. While we are actively monitoring the changes in global trade policy and the effects they may have on our business and broader macroeconomic environment, we have not experienced a material impact on our financial position to date and do not expect them to have a material detrimental impact on our business operations in the near term. However, given the uncertainty surrounding global markets as a result of the fluid U.S. tariff policy, we do not have clarity at this point over the potential medium to long term impacts our business may face. The availability of certain goods could be affected if foreign suppliers choose to limit their exposure to U.S. markets in response to unfavorable trade policies, which could negatively impact our suppliers ability to deliver materials or manufacture equipment for us and, therefore, delay or impede our product deliveries. Furthermore, rising inflation, slower economic growth and increases in unemployment that may result from global trade disruptions could further deflate consumer demand and impact the demand for our products.

In this section, we discuss the results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. For a discussion of the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, please refer to Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, which was filed with the SEC on February 27, 2025.

paragraphs: Arlo Technologies, Inc. ("we" or "Arlo") 正在改變人們保護他們所珍視事物的方式，透過先進的居家、商業與個人安全服務，結合全球規模的雲端平台、先進的監測與分析功能，以及獲獎的應用程式控制裝置，建立個人化的安全生態系統。Arlo 在雲端服務、先進的人工智慧 ("AI") 與電腦視覺分析、無線連接及直覺使用者體驗設計方面的深厚專業知識，為 Arlo 使用者提供順暢、智慧型居家安全解決方案，設置與日常使用皆輕鬆易上手。我們高度安全的雲端平台，為使用者提供視野、洞察力及強大的手段，以協助保護並即時與最重要的親人與物品連線，從任何擁有 Wi-Fi 或行動網路連線的地點皆可使用，並根植於對用戶及其個人資料隱私的保護承諾。

截至目前為止，我們已推出 Arlo Secure、Arlo Total Security 和 Arlo Safe 等訂閱服務，以及多種獲獎的智慧安全裝置類別，包括智慧 Wi-Fi 和 LTE 連接的攝影機、視訊門鈴、防洪攝影機與居家安全系統。此外，Arlo 的廣泛相容性使平台能順暢整合第三方網路物聯網 ("IoT") 產品與協議，例如 Amazon Alexa、Apple HomeKit、Apple TV、Google Assistant 和 Samsung SmartThings。我們計畫持續在攝影機及其他類別中推出新的智慧安全裝置至 Arlo 平台，增加平台註冊帳號數量，透過移動應用程式保持高參與度，並透過提供付費訂閱服務產生增量的重複收入。

我們的總可達市場包括使用智慧安全裝置保護親人與財產的個人與企業所有者。在居家之外，我們的行動網路裝置已在多種使用情境中被採用，例如社區監視、建設工地監測、野生動物與戶外步道監視以及活動監測。我們相信小型企業、政府與直接居家監測渠道為我們的成長領域，除了我們的零售與電商業務。我們的軟體即服務 ("SaaS") 解決方案包括 Arlo Secure，這是一項訂閱服務，提供無限攝影機覆蓋與增強的緊急應變解決方案，Arlo Total Security 是一項全面的訂閱服務，包含專業監測與安全硬體，Arlo Safe 是一項個人安全服務，搭配緊急按鈕配件，以及 Arlo SmartCloud，這是一項提供高效率與安全雲端服務的解決方案。我們相信我們已具備優勢，可將目前的影響力擴展至更廣泛的物聯網市場，無論是在家內或家外，並持續在智慧安全平台中推出新產品與服務。

Arlo Secure 是我們的訂閱服務，提供先進的 AI 基於偵測、DIY 居家安全以及專業監測，並具備增強的緊急應變能力。這些高階服務支援無限家庭安全裝置，並具備先進的 AI 物件偵測，以及更智慧、互動性更高的通知。此外，24/7 的一鍵緊急應變功能在 Secure Premium 計畫中可用，讓 Arlo 使用者在緊急情況下可直接派遣救難人員，以加快行動。Arlo Secure 的訂閱服務可與多種 Arlo 相機、居家安全與門鈴產品搭配使用。Arlo Secure 訂閱服務的特點包括：
•AI 動力辨識與偵測 – 藉由先進的電腦視覺 AI 與辨識引擎，Arlo Secure 6 提供事件標籤、視訊搜尋、先進的視訊與音訊偵測功能，讓使用者能做出有關安全與安全的明智決策。使用者可訓練 Arlo AI 來建立個人化、客製化的偵測，以保護他們所珍視的事物，並教導 Arlo 相機辨識特定物件或視野變更，以觸發客製化通知。
•緊急應變 – 在 Arlo Secure 應用程式中，使用者可透過一鍵直接派遣消防、警察或醫療救護人員至攝影機所在地點。若使用者指示，Arlo 的緊急應變團隊也可提供關鍵的定位資訊給救護人員，以更好地準備，例如閘門密碼、家庭成員的醫療狀況及寵物資訊。
•2K 和 4K 雲端視訊錄影 – 查看 Arlo 的 SmartCloud 平台安全儲存的 60 天錄影，以確保最終的安心與保護，即使裝置遭竊或在入侵、暴風雨或其他物理事件中損壞。
•無限攝影機 – 使用者可透過一個全面的計畫享受 Arlo Secure 服務，用於家中所有攝影機，並可免費加入新購入的 Arlo 相機，不需額外服務費用。
•進階物件偵測 – Arlo 透過進階物件偵測技術，結合視覺 AI，每日處理及過濾約 300 百萬事件，以更準確識別人、包裹、車輛及動物，為通知增加關鍵情境資訊，並減少無關警報。
•智慧互動通知 – 使用者可透過手機螢幕鎖定畫面，快速回應豐富的通知內容或觀看通知影片的動畫預覽，以採取更迅速的行動。
•煙霧及一氧化碳警報偵測 – 當相機偵測到煙霧或一氧化碳警報被觸發時，使用者會收到通知。
•基於雲端的活動區域設定 – 使用者可透過標示財產上特定區域，來減少無關通知，並設定需偵測運動的區域。
•呼叫朋友 – 使用者可透過 Arlo App，從通知畫面點擊一次即刻呼叫朋友。
•24 小時優先技術支援 – 使用者可透過應用程式內的 Help Center 獲得優先技術支援，並透過電話、聊天、社羣或自學文章等多渠道取得協助。

此討論包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。這些前瞻性陳述並非歷史事實，而是基於目前的預期、估計、假設與對我們產業、業務與未來財務結果的預測。我們的實際結果可能因多種因素而與這些前瞻性陳述所預期的結果有重大差異，包括在上述「風險因素」中討論的那些因素。

Arlo 正在改變人們保護他們所珍視的事物的方式，透過先進的居家、商業與個人安全服務，結合全球規模的雲端平台、先進的監測與分析功能，以及獲獎肯定的應用程式控制裝置，創造個人化的安全生態系統。Arlo 在雲端服務、尖端 AI 與電腦視覺分析、無線連接與直覺使用者體驗設計方面的深厚專業，為 Arlo 使用者提供順暢、智慧型居家安全解決方案，設置與日常使用皆輕鬆易上手。我們高度安全的雲端平台，讓使用者能即時看見、洞察並透過強大的功能保護與連接他們最珍視的人與事物，從任何有 Wi-Fi 或行動網路連接的地點皆可使用，這一切皆建立在對用戶及其個人資料隱私的保護承諾之上。
自 2014 年 12 月我們首個產品問世以來，我們已出貨超過 42.7 百萬臺智慧安全裝置。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Arlo 平台在全球超過 100 個國家擁有約 12.1 百萬個累計註冊帳號，並搭配約 5.7 百萬個累計付費帳號，以及年複合收入 330.5 百萬美元。

我們的業務分佈於三個地理區域—(i) 美洲；(ii) 歐洲、中東與非洲（"EMEA"）；以及 (iii) 亞太（"APAC"）—我們主要透過銷售付費訂閱服務，以及透過零售、批發分銷、電信業者通路、安全解決方案供應商，以及 Arlo 的直銷消費者商店來產生收入。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日與 2024 年 12 月 31 日，我們分別產生總營收 529.3 百萬美元與 510.9 百萬美元。營業所得為 6.1 百萬美元，而營業虧損為 34.9 百萬美元。

我們的目標是持續開發創新、世界級的智慧安全解決方案，以擴展並進一步 monetize 我們目前與未來的用戶與付費帳號基礎。我們認為，我們業務的成長取決於許多因素，包括我們創新與及時推出成功的新產品的能力、擴大我們的裝置基礎、增加訂閱式重複收入、投資於通路與其他戰略合作夥伴，以及持續進行全球擴張。我們預期將增加對研究與開發的投資，以持續推出新穎且創新產品與服務，提升 Arlo 平台並與工程人才競爭。我們也預期未來銷售與行銷費用將增加，因我們投資於行銷以推動對我們產品與服務的需求。

除了我們合併財務報表中所呈現的指標外，我們還使用以下關鍵指標來評估業務、衡量表現、制定財務預測並做出戰略決策。我們認為這些關鍵業務指標提供有用的資訊，使我們能做出更具意義的期間對期間比較，並更好地瞭解管理層如何規劃與衡量我們的基礎業務。我們的關鍵業務指標可能與其他公司使用的相同指標計算方式不同。我們定期審查這些指標的計算方式，有時會發現需要調整以更符合我們的業務。我們認為任何這樣的調整除非另有說明，否則都是不重要的。
累計註冊帳號。註冊帳號於特定期間結算時，定義為在 Arlo 平台上的獨特註冊帳號數量。Arlo 平台上的註冊帳號數量並不會直接對應至用戶數量。一個帳號可能由多個用戶共享（我們視為一個帳號），且一個用戶可能擁有多個帳號（我們視為多個帳號）。
累計付費帳號。特定期間結算時的付費帳號，定義為全球任何帳號，若 Arlo 透過訂閱制或其他持續性服務費收取費用（無論是直接自用戶或透過合作夥伴收取）。
年度持續性營收。我們認為 ARR 可用以衡量我們的業務策略，並作為我們未來成長的指標。ARR 代表且定義為我們預期從訂閱合約中認列的年度付費訂閱與服務營收，計算方式為取報表期間平均每個付費帳號的付費訂閱與服務營收，乘以報表期間結算時的付費帳號數量。ARR 是績效指標，應獨立於營業收入與遞延收入來觀察，並非用以取代或與這些項目結合。

美國政府實施新的關稅措施，影響廣泛進口材料。某些國家已針對美國關稅採取或威脅採取報復性關稅。雖然我們持續監測全球貿易政策的變化及其對我們業務與總體經濟環境的影響，但截至目前為止，我們尚未對財務狀況造成重大影響，也不預期在近期對我們業務運作造成重大負面影響。然而，考慮到美國關稅政策的流動性所造成的全球市場不確定性，目前我們尚無法明確判斷未來中長期可能對我們業務造成的影響。若外國供應商選擇限制其對美國市場的曝險，以回應不利的貿易政策，某些商品的供應可能會受到影響，這可能會影響我們供應商交付材料或為我們製造設備的能力，進而延遲或阻礙我們產品的出貨。此外，因全球貿易幹擾而導致的通貨膨脹上升、經濟成長放緩與失業率上升，可能會進一步壓抑消費者需求，並影響我們產品的需求。

本節我們討論 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的營運結果，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的比較。如需瞭解 2024 年 12 月 31 日結算日與 2023 年 12 月 31 日結算日的比較，請參閱我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日結算日的年度報告 10-K 表單，該報告於 2025 年 2 月 27 日提交至 SEC，其中的 "管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析" 部分（Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations"）

paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及相當風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告表10-K中所有其他資訊，包括財務報表及其相關附註與「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」，以評估本公司業務並決定是否投資本公司普通股。我們在下文中說明我們認為目前所面臨的重要風險與不確定性，但並非我們所面臨的唯一風險與不確定性。我們可能還會面臨其他風險與不確定性，這些風險與不確定性我們尚未察覺，或目前認為不具重大影響，但未來可能成為影響本公司業務的重要因素。如果上述任何風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與未來展望造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。
我們從有限或獨家來源供應商取得多項關鍵零組件，如果這些供應商無法滿足我們的供應需求，或我們無法妥善管理與第三方製造商的供應需求，我們可能失去銷售並面臨零組件成本上升的問題。

任何關鍵產品零組件的供應短缺或延遲，將會影響我們履行預定產品交貨的能力建立。我們產品中使用的許多零組件是專門為我們的產品設計的，其中一些來自獨家供應商。這些零組件包括為Arlo應用程式量身打造的鏡頭、鏡頭感測器與無動感紅外線感測器，以及具備節能與安全功能的客製化電池。此外，我們終端產品中使用的零組件已進行優化，以延長電池使用壽命。我們的第三方製造商通常代表我們購買這些零組件，我們與供應商之間並無任何契約承諾或保證供應安排。如果某項零組件的需求增加，我們可能無法及時或完全取得足夠數量的該零組件。此外，如果全球對這些零組件的需求大幅增加，這些零組件的供應可能受到限制。另外，我們的供應商可能因全球經濟狀況不確定且低迷而面臨財務或其他困難。影響我們供應商供應零組件能力或意願的其他因素包括內部管理或重整問題，例如新設備的推出可能延遲或幹擾預期的零組件供應，或產業併購與資產處分，可能導致某些供應商的業務與產品優先順序發生變化。取得這些零組件的替代來源，或改變產品設計以使用替代零組件，可能困難、成本高昂且耗時。此外，從現有供應商轉換至新供應商的困難，可能導致零組件供應延遲，對我們履行產品訂單的能力造成重大影響。

我們通常會為第三方製造商提供一個滾動的預測需求，他們利用此預測來決定我們的物料與零組件需求。訂購物料與零組件的前置時間差異很大，並取決於多種因素，例如特定供應商、契約條款以及某個時間點該零組件的供需情況。我們的一些零組件具有較長的前置時間，例如無線區域網路晶片組、物理層轉接器、連接器與金屬與塑膠外殼。如果我們未能及時提供預測，或預測低於實際需求，第三方製造商可能無法及時或完全製造產品。如果我們的預測過高，第三方製造商將無法使用他們代表我們購買的零組件。我們產品中使用的零組件成本，隨著產量增加與技術成熟，通常會迅速下降。因此，如果第三方製造商無法及時使用我們代表他們購買的零組件，我們的產品製造成本可能會高於競爭對手，因為會有過多高價零組件的庫存。此外，如果他們無法使用我們指示訂購的零組件，我們將需要賠償他們所遭受的損失。
如果我們無法取得足夠的零組件，或遭遇零組件供應中斷，我們的產品出貨可能減少或延遲，或我們取得這些零組件的成本可能上升。此外，高度專業化零組件的獨家供應商可能提供，或已提供不符合我們或我們製造商、零售商、經銷商或其他通路夥伴所要求標準的零組件，導致延遲、損失營收機會，並可能造成重大寫銷。
